items.label: Recursion Bank of America SMID Cap Virtual Conference 2026 (08-11-2026)
items.signal_prefix: REC-4881 (FAP), CFO Ben Taylor: FAP patients undergo on average

set.signal: REC-4881 (FAP), CFO Ben Taylor: FAP patients undergo on average about 10 major surgeries and about 70 treatments with excisions over their lifetime. He said Recursion is 'the first drug to ever show that you could take the patient off drug and maintain that response', with a slight deepening of response over three months off drug, and that the effect is seen in both upper and lower GI, whereas eRapa (encapsulated rapamycin) showed a little under a 20% response after 12 months, all in the lower GI. For the FDA discussions on pivotal design (described as productive), Recursion built an LLM model using over 250,000 patient records to study standard clinical practice and created a natural history database with a university in the Netherlands that tracked FAP patients over 20 years, showing continuous annual polyp growth averaging 'north of 50%'; he said Recursion would be fine even with the same trial design as the existing trial. Longer follow-up and data on managing known MEK1/2 side effects will be presented at the upcoming FAP physicians' conference, where Recursion presents at the presidential plenary.

items.reason: 'November' is stated only by the BofA analyst (and the Investing.com summary), not by Ben Taylor; management only said 'the upcoming conference' / presidential plenary
items.evidence: we are presenting at the presidential plenary with the data. ... We will give you additional data on that at the upcoming conference.

items.label: Schrödinger Morgan Stanley healthcare conference 2026 (09-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: President of R&D Karen Akinsanya: having decided last year

set.signal: President of R&D Karen Akinsanya: having decided last year not to take programs into the clinic, Schrödinger moves programs through discovery and then partners them; the Tectora spin-out of two immunology programs 'raised $55 million', which will fund them through discovery and, it hopes, into early clinical development, taking that CRO cost off Schrödinger's balance sheet. Schrödinger holds 'a pretty significant equity stake' and Tectora is 'I think our eighth new co' under the Schrödinger umbrella. She said the $750 million is 'a collection of events' combining upfronts, milestones, royalties and cash distributions from sales of co-founded biotechs or their assets - Nimbus asset sales and the acquisitions of Morphic, Petra and Ajax.
set.figure: Tectora raised $55 million; eighth newco; $750 million (upfronts, milestones, royalties and cash distributions)

items.reason: Source says '$750 million' (moderator: '$750 million in kind of exits'; Akinsanya: 'the $750, it's a collection of events'); 'more than' and 'realized' are not in this source
items.evidence: Yeah, maybe just on the, sorry, the $750, it's a collection of events. ... Those distributions of cash are part of that $750 million.
